description.plain:
Stay protected in wet and unpredictable weather with the Torrentshell Jacket, designed using H2No® Performance Standard technology for long-term comfort and waterproof durability. Constructed with a 3-layer recycled nylon shell and a DWR (durable water repellent) finish, this jacket delivers superior protection in storms and steady drizzles. The tricot backer ensures next-to-skin comfort, while the jacket self-stuffs into the left-hand pocket for easy transport, complete with a convenient carabiner clip-in loop.

Every detail is engineered for performance and convenience. The adjustable hood with laminated visor rolls and stows easily using a simple cord-and-hook design. The center-front zipper is protected with interior and exterior storm flaps, and the jacket includes pit zips and handwarmer pockets with DWR-treated zippers for added functionality. A microfleece-lined neck, hook-and-loop cuff closures, and an adjustable drawcord hem provide additional comfort and a secure seal against precipitation.
